deviceSetup.title: Information
deviceSetup.rotateConfirmText: Generating a new secret will invalidate the current one. Update your device configuration afterwards.
deviceSetup.overview: Add a device for your plant, then open Device setup from its tile menu to set reading and pump options. DIY users can email Arduino/ESP code, enter their Wi-Fi details and upload it by USB. Compatible universal firmware will use QR and BLE pairing.
deviceSetup.authenticationInfo: Legacy DIY devices share an account secret. Rotating it invalidates all those devices. Paired devices use individual credentials that are never displayed here.

deviceDetails.title: Device setup
deviceDetails.description: Legacy DIY devices share an account secret. Rotating it invalidates all those devices. Paired devices use individual credentials that are never displayed here.

wateringSchedule.title: Schedule watering
wateringSchedule.description: Manual watering works by creating a pending pump job for this device. The mobile app does not run the pump directly. Instead, the backend stores the scheduled job, and the Arduino board checks for pending jobs when it sends its next reading. If a pending job exists and the board has pump-control logic, it can start the water pump and then mark the job as executed.
wateringSchedule.pendingJob: A watering job is currently scheduled and waiting for the device to pick it up.
wateringSchedule.noPendingJob: There is no pending watering job for this device.
wateringSchedule.step1: When you schedule watering, the backend stores a pending pump job for this device.
wateringSchedule.step2: The Arduino board normally sends readings about once per hour. During that request, it can also ask the backend whether a pump job is waiting.
wateringSchedule.step3: If the board has pump-control logic and finds a pending job, it can start the pump and then report that the job was executed.
wateringSchedule.step4: Manual scheduled watering is independent from automatic moisture-based watering. It does not check the current soil moisture level before running.
wateringSchedule.pumpRequiredText: This device is not configured with a water pump. Enable water pump support in the device settings before scheduling watering.
wateringSchedule.firmwareDuration: Uses the duration set in the board's code.
wateringSchedule.durationHint: Choose 1–300 seconds. Automatic watering still uses the duration set in the board's code.
wateringSchedule.durationFirmwareRequired: To choose a duration, upload the latest device code and wait for the board to connect. Until then, manual watering uses the duration set in its code.

export.title: Send readings export
export.noticeTitle: The Excel export will use the currently applied criteria.
export.noticeFiltered: Only readings data matching the filters shown below will be included. If you need different data, change the filters first and then send again.
export.noticeAllData: No filters are currently applied, so the export will include all available readings data for this screen.

upsert.noPlantsText: You don’t have any plants yet. Please add a plant first to link a device.
upsert.moistAlertLabel: Send alerts when soil moisture is beneath threshold
upsert.notificationsSoilMoistureInfo: Soil moisture alerts are available only when the Soil Moisture sensor is enabled.
upsert.sendEmailNotifications: Send email notifications when soil moisture is beneath threshold
upsert.sendPushNotifications: Send push notifications when soil moisture is beneath threshold
upsert.pumpIncluded: Include water pump with this device
upsert.automaticPumpLaunch: Automatic pump launch when soil moisture is beneath threshold
upsert.wateringNotificationsInfo: Watering completion notifications are available only when this device has an included water pump. They can be sent after scheduled watering completes or after automatic watering is triggered and completed.
upsert.sendEmailWateringNotifications: Send email notification when watering is complete
upsert.sendPushWateringNotifications: Send push notification when watering is complete
upsert.intervalFirmwareHint: Choose 1–1440 minutes (default 60). After changing the interval, generate and upload the updated board code.
upsert.pumpCooldownHint: Choose 1–32767 minutes (default 60). The server applies this value when the board next checks for watering tasks. It does not change watering duration.
upsert.pumpCooldownInvalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to 32767.
upsert.intervalMinutesValidation: Enter a whole number from 1 to 1440.
upsert.sendEmailMissingReadings: Send email when readings are not received
upsert.sendPushMissingReadings: Send push notification when readings are not received
upsert.missingReadingsInfo: For active devices, notify once when a reading is overdue. A new reading resets the alert. These options work independently of soil moisture and watering notifications.
upsert.pumpDurationHint: Choose 1–300 seconds (default 20). This sets the duration in generated device code. Generate and upload the code again to apply a change. Scheduled watering can use a different duration.
upsert.pumpDurationInvalid: Enter a whole number from 1 to 300.

configuration.title: Device setup
configuration.legacySaved: Saved in Flovers; device application not confirmed
configuration.legacyConfigurationHint: For DIY devices, changing the interval or pump duration requires generating and uploading the code again. Cooldown and automatic watering settings are fetched when the board checks for tasks.
configuration.saveFailed: Could not save configuration. Your changes are still here; try again.
configuration.pairingUnavailable: BLE pairing and Wi-Fi reconfiguration are not available in this version yet. DIY code generation remains available below.

pairing.title: Pair device
pairing.description: Choose your device entry. Flovers confirms pairing only after the board contacts the server and applies its settings.
pairing.noDevices: Create a device in Readings first.
pairing.wifiHint: Power the board on to open its five-minute BLE setup window. Use a 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi network. Leave the password empty for an open network.
pairing.replacement: Replace the current board and revoke its access. Existing readings and pump cooldown remain.
pairing.verifying: Waiting for server and device confirmation…
pairing.scanHint: Scan the factory QR on an ESP32 device to pair it. Plant QR codes still open plant details.
pairing.deviceQrRequired: Scan a device QR code, not a plant QR code.
pairing.invalidQr: This QR code is not supported.
